## alice-dms-path-worker

Sub-workflow, invoked exclusively by alice-dms-scanner's Dispatcher via
Execute Workflow (fire-and-forget, waitForSubWorkflow=false) — one call per
successfully locked watched folder (PROJ-72). No schedule trigger of its own.

Receives {id, path, suggested_type, lock_owner} from the Dispatcher.
Recursively scans exactly that one folder, then runs the full existing
per-file pipeline (hash, lifecycle check, 5s stability check, OCR check,
MQTT routing by type) — same logic as the pre-PROJ-72 alice-dms-scanner,
now scoped to a single folder so independent folders process in true
parallel executions instead of one shared file loop.

### Redis Lock (PROJ-72)
- `alice:dms:scanner:lock:folder:<folder_id>` — renewed once per file (ownership-checked);
  if renewal ever fails (lost ownership or Redis error — fail-closed), the worker
  self-aborts immediately (throws) rather than risk double-processing a file
  another worker now owns.
- Released exactly once at the end of the run (no-files branch or after the
  file loop completes), also ownership-checked.

### Run Time Limit (PROJ-94)
- Per folder run, checked once per file alongside the lock renewal: if more than
  2h (7200s) elapsed since `alice:dms:scanner:stats:folder:<folder_id>:run_start`,
  `IF: Time Limit Reached` routes to `Code: Abort on Time Limit`, which logs the
  progress so far and hands over to the normal summary + lock release path
  (clean abort, lock freed, no further files this run).
- Fail-open: if Redis is unreachable during the time check, the run continues;
  lock-loss detection stays the primary safeguard against hung runs.
- Unscanned files are picked up by the next hourly dispatcher run - no data loss.

### Per-Folder Stats Redis Keys (PROJ-72)
- `alice:dms:scanner:stats:folder:<folder_id>:{scanned_files,new_files,skipped_files,
  lifecycle_files,errors,run_start}` — reset at the start of EACH invocation (not shared
  across concurrently running workers for different folders).
Published to alice/dms/scanner/path_stats on completion.

### Redis Key Pattern (unchanged from PROJ-21)
- `alice:dms:processed`, `alice:dms:queued_files`, `alice:dms:path_to_hash`,
  `alice:dms:hash_to_paths:<hash>` — same dedup/lifecycle mechanism as before,
  untouched by PROJ-72.
